lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet Ana, a resident of Mint Town. Coffee before work. Groceries for home. She checks her wallet: enough left for the week. These little payments are part of her routine. She's done this a hundred times. Then a message interrupts her morning. It says her wallet is at risk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It uses the wallet's name and says she has only five minutes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The link opens a convincing copy of her wallet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Move money to a safe account. Keep it secret.

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: It looks real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then, nine hundred pesos disappear.

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Wait—what? My money's gone!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She files a report. Then comes the wait. Days can pass with her case unresolved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her story is one of many across financial services. In six ASEAN markets, ninety-six percent worried about scams or hacking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Forty-five percent of reported cases remained unresolved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One wallet's published investigation window: two to seven days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But what if there's a faster way to resolve her case?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet Resolution Agent—clarity when it matters.

lines.speaker: ana
lines.text: Please help me. I clicked the link... my money's gone!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It brings her report, transactions, and wallet history into one clear case.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The analyst gets connected evidence, ready to review.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The agent can call trained models and classifiers as tools.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here, it chooses a fraud classifier for the transaction.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The result becomes one piece of evidence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It combines the evidence and drafts a resolution for review.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Resolution Agent turns scattered information into a review-ready case.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A human fraud analyst verifies the evidence and decides what happens next.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Less time gathering data. More time helping the customer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Reviewed cases become shared knowledge for the prevention agent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It learns the warning pattern: a safe account, and demands for secrecy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That pattern can be tested against new recipients and ordinary payments.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Later, Jun gets a similar text. A new link. A different recipient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the request repeats the same instructions: safe account, keep it secret.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The reviewed safeguard recognizes the pattern.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This time, the suspicious payment is paused before money leaves. His everyday coffee payment still goes through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Resolution Agent. Close the gap from report to resolution. Give fraud analysts clarity—and customers a way forward.
